newsitem.title: GERMANY: Duerr shares boosted by Audi order.
newsitem.headline: Duerr shares boosted by Audi order.

text.p: Shares in German plant manufacturer Duerr AG were up nearly four percent in pre-bourse trade on Tuesday after it announced a big new order for carmaker Audi AG.
Shares in Duerr were up two marks at 53 marks, a gain of 3.92 percent, compared to the overall market which was up 14.39 points at 2,564.10 points, a gain of 0.56 percent.
Duerr said it had won an order worth about 400 million marks to build a paint shop for Audi AG.
